B Extradition Act, 1962 (as amended by Amending Act of 1993) : Section 21-Scope and ambit of-Criminal courts-Jurisdiction of-To try offences not included in extradition judgment-Fugitive criminals- C Extradition of-Accused extradited from USA for trial of certain offences included in the TADA-Held: A fugitive brought into India under an Extradition Decree can be tried only for the offences mentioned in the Extradition Decree and for no other offence­ Hence, criminal courts in India have no jurisdiction to try such fugitive for D any other offence.
